title: Restaurant occupancy code
text:
Restaurant occupancy code

Touchstone
 supports the following restaurant
 occupancy class code.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and
 limitations for specific models, refer to the model documentation that is available on
 the 
Client Portal
.

Note:
 The associated Standard Industrial Classification
 (SIC) code is listed for the occupancy code.

| Occupancy code | Category | SIC2-digit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 331 | Restaurants | 58 | This occupancy code includes restaurants, fast food centers, cafÃ©s, and
 bars. Valid for all exposures in the U.S., South America, Australia, Canada,
 the Caribbean, Japan, South Korea, China, and Taiwan, and for exposures
 covered for wind in Europe. In other regions, use commercial occupancy code 312 for
 restaurants. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand . |
